title: Coordinate slice of a Boolean function
statement: For a Boolean function $g$ on $n+1$ sign coordinates and a sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, define its slice at $b$ by fixing the first coordinate to $b$ and evaluating $g$ on the remaining $n$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on $n+1$ sign coordinates
